summary: Min Thin Keller, writing from River Falls, Wisconsin, expresses concern and opposition regarding the plan regulating off-road vehicles on public lands. She objects to ORV use on private property, finding the noise threatening to wildlife's refuge and to other humans who seek the peace and quiet of nature. She urges that the noise of man-made machines not be allowed to encroach on natural areas.
